'''abominable Power House Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[abominable]]
* '''Published:''' 24 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Forest Clearing|Endor-D-endorforestclearing.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor: Forest Clearing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Endor Forest Clearing abominable.txt |Download]]

crush you anywere
